programme.title: The Best Man
programme.desc: Miss Mona (Dolly Parton) runs the Chicken Ranch, a brothel with a long history in a small Texas town. The locals have a good relationship with the institution, and Mona is respected in the community. The sheriff, Ed Earl Dodd (Burt Reynolds), also looks out for the Chicken Ranch due to his past with Miss Mona. However, when pious reporter Melvin Thorpe (Dom DeLuise) exposes the brothel, outside interests want it shut down, putting the governor (Charles Durning) in a tough spot.

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws!

programme.title: Preseason Week 1 Highlights
programme.desc: After the Carolina Panthers rallied to gain a 31-27 lead with 2:39 remaining on a 7-yard touchdown pass from quarterback Bryce Young to wide receiver Jalen Coker, Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford led Los Angeles on a go-ahead scoring drive capped by his 19-yard touchdown pass to regain the lead for L.A. with 38 seconds left. Rams safety Quentin Lake broke up Bryce Young's final pass attempt on the ensuing Panthers' offensive drive to secure a Rams victory and ticket to the NFC Divisional Round.

programme.title: Olly’s Quest For Fame
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho
programme.sub-title: 'Lo que modifica ni se recuerda ni se platica'
programme.desc: Una joven trabaja para ayudar a su madre que está enferma, un día es asaltada y pierde el dinero de la renta, por lo que son sacadas de su casa. El destino une a la chica con un joven, quien resulta ser el hermano del ladrón que le robó el dinero.

programme.desc: À Chypre, le grec et l'anglais sont les principales langues de communication, mais le français a une présence millénaire. Langue de coeur dans les écoles, elle est aussi parlée par de nombreux francophones qui aiment faire découvrir les spécialités chypriotes en français : le fromage halloumi, le vin, l'huile d'olive.
